revision: Final approved Gambit destination copy with unchanged compact typography and fixed four-card layout
assessmentType: Independent subjective assessment of Crownfall-specific copy, honest action labels, and the requested card-heading size, weight and state colors. Current desktop and phone-landscape screenshots inspected against the original scene and the new private typography reference. Not a pixel-match or performance score.

rubric.notes: All four actual-image Gambit cards remain visible at once in the fixed 197x298 row. At 1280x720 the row remains 800px wide with 4px gaps and no carousel controls. Desktop and letterboxed phone-landscape captures preserve the complete row.

rubric.category: Actual supplied artwork and focal crops
rubric.notes: Existing actual JPEG imagery and portrait focal positions remain unchanged. Wheel, blue gateway, timber bridges and crystal cliffs remain identifiable. Panoramic context is necessarily omitted by the portrait crops.

rubric.category: Reference typography, truthful Crownfall copy and readability
rubric.notes: Compact Barlow600 headings remain amber for selected Resume Gambit and muted gray for inactive cards. All titles, approved destination-intention subtitles and short bodies fit desktop and 844px landscape views. Browse has the approved unavailable subtitle and no body. Activation dialogs retain explicit demo-only limits; supporting copy remains small on landscape phones.

rubric.category: Creature direction, framing and coordinated arm tilt
rubric.notes: The actual creature is subtly larger, turns and leans toward the cards, and all arms follow naturally through the parent transform. Crown and eye have clear space in the reviewed screenshots. Face and orbital rings remain visible above the row; shoulder, arm and robe remain visible around it. No bone-level pose distortion observed.

Existing warm gold fog and teal particles remain cohesive with the supplied images and actual model. The slightly leftward creature attention improves its relationship to the cards. Materials and geometry still differ from the original illustrated reference by design.

iterationHistory.findings: Crownfall/Gambit naming and functional boundaries were accurate. Critic suggested the precise New subtitle Name your gambit and less repetitive Browse unavailability copy.

Home/Browse screenshots exposed an unsupported decorative diagonal-arrow glyph. Root replaced it with a supported aria-hidden ASCII chevron. Landscape modal content supports vertical scrolling without horizontal overflow.

iterationHistory.iteration: Final copy and typography reference review
iterationHistory.findings: Selected amber and inactive gray bold compact headings match the new reference style. All Gambit titles fit the unchanged four-card row at desktop and landscape sizes. Source copy remains truthful, concise and rooted in existing Crownfall identity. No blocking issue.

Independently inspected all three refreshed screenshots and exact source/inventory wording. Short approved card text and empty Browse body fit cleanly. Explicit New/Resume/Load activation disclosures remain, including the new Load inability-to-restore sentence. No styling or layout change; prior 9.3 assessment retained.

model.fallback: Illustration retained for unavailable or unsupported model rendering

authorizedDifferences: Cards use the latest approved Gambit destination-intention subtitles and short bodies, including an empty Browse body; prototype limitations remain explicit in activation dialogs.
Home / Play / Settings replace placeholder example tabs; Back replaces the misleading Quit label.
Card-heading typography changes only to compact bold size/weight and amber/gray availability states based on the new private reference.
Exactly four 197x298 cards, actual supplied images, focal crops, creature transform and atmosphere remain unchanged.
Modal descriptions honestly state that the menu stores demo setup metadata, gameplay and online play are not connected, and the saved audio preference has no connected audio.
Desktop and phone landscape composition only; no portrait redesign.
remainingLimits: Supporting copy remains very small on phone landscape; long modal content uses vertical scrolling in short viewports.

Card wording describes the intended full-game destinations. Current preview actions only create/view demo setup metadata or navigate; they do not start or restore chess gameplay. Online play and audio remain unconnected and are disclosed in activation/settings dialogs.
Portrait crops and actual creature materials differ from the original illustration; exact screenshot reproduction is not claimed.
The private typography reference is retained locally and is not included as an image in the repository.
The 9.3 score is subjective visual judgment for the current copy/typography revision; prior designs are historical.
verdict: Retains the subjective 9.3/10 assessment: approved concise Gambit destination copy fits the unchanged four-card composition at desktop and phone-landscape sizes, with prototype-only behavior disclosed on activation. No blocking visual or wording issue identified.

suppliedArtwork.sourceInspection: Four original JPEG files visually inspected at /workspace/crownfall-card-originals before reviewing browser crops. Delivery image dimensions and provenance hashes documented separately.

creatureTransform.method: Parent transform only; four arms follow the same rig; no bone overrides or animation clip changes.

creatureComparison.matchedPose: Idle at time 0 with OS reduced motion
creatureComparison.interpretation: The held-constant carousel layout in this matched pair predates the latest restored small-card row. Use the pair only to isolate creature scale, turn, lean and arm tilt. Current UI is represented by the final screenshots above.
creatureComparison.findings: Eye and orbital rings turn toward the cards; subtle top-left lean and matching arm tilt read naturally. Final lower placement restores crown clearance; no additional transform change needed.

currentEvidence.scope: Visual critic independently inspected screenshots and matched before/after creature captures. Functional assertions are supported by the separate verification artifacts.

typographyReference.observedStyle: Compact approximately 14px bold uppercase heading at 960px; selected amber, inactive muted gray, availability-disabled Continue dimmer.

headingTypography.notes: All four cards open actual preview or informational dialogs, so no card was artificially disabled merely to mimic the unavailable Continue example.

copyAudit.identity: Crownfall — A King's Gambit Story; Every sacrifice has a name; cinematic chess. No new factions or characters invented.
copyAudit.navigation: Home / Play / Settings only. Duplicate EXAMPLE tabs and fake notification removed. Footer Back accurately names the Home-return action.

cards.New Gambit: Approved destination-intention wording: Begin a new gambit. / Choose your opening. Every move has a cost. Activation still explicitly creates demo setup metadata rather than starting chess gameplay.
cards.Resume Gambit: Approved destination-intention wording: Return to your gambit. / Continue where you left the board. Activation still explicitly cannot restore a chess position or launch gameplay.
cards.Load Gambit: Approved destination-intention wording: Choose a saved gambit. / Return to a saved position. Load dialog explicitly says: One local demo save slot. Chess positions cannot be restored in this preview.
cards.Browse Gambits: Approved subtitle: Unavailable in this build. Body is empty. Activation retains the online-unavailable informational state.

copyAudit.settings: Particle quality and motion describe actual menu effects. Volume is explicitly a saved preference with audio not connected.
copyAudit.copyPolish: Latest user-approved destination-intention card text applied exactly, with empty Browse body. Prototype limitations remain in activation dialogs and actual CTA labels. Supported aria-hidden ASCII chevrons remain in use. No CSS, typography, geometry, model or artwork changes.
